tbesh_html:
1) to move, go, turn back, move away, backslide
1a) (Qal) to backslide, prove recreant to
1b) (Niphal)
1b1) to turn oneself away, turn back
1b2) to be turned or driven back, be repulsed
Also means: sug (שׂוּג "to turn back" H7734)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to flinch, i.e. (by implication) to go back, literally (to retreat) or figuratively (to apostatize)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: backslider, drive, go back, turn (away, back).
